profile.reference: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 - Annex I Part II (vulnerability handling) and Article 13 (technical documentation)
profile.obligation: Manufacturers must handle vulnerabilities throughout the support period and keep records of the security-relevant processes that back the technical documentation.

mappings.requirement: Record how vulnerabilities are identified, triaged, and remediated
mappings.howProofLogHelps: Each triage and remediation decision is an append-only, time-stamped, attributable record - the trail behind the Annex VII technical file.

mappings.requirement: Demonstrate the records were not altered after the fact
mappings.howProofLogHelps: The hash chain detects any edit, reorder, insertion, or deletion; with signing, even a full rewrite by someone without the key is caught.

mappings.requirement: Evidence the timeline of incident handling and reporting (Article 14)
mappings.howProofLogHelps: Every event carries a UTC timestamp bound into its hash, so the recorded 24h / 72h / 14-day sequence is tamper-evident: the timeline cannot be quietly rewritten after the fact.

disclaimer: ProofLog provides a tamper-evident, identity-bound record-keeping mechanism. This export documents the integrity of the recorded events; it does not by itself constitute or guarantee regulatory compliance, and it is not legal advice.

records.data: {"id":"ANNEX-I-II-SBOM","note":"2 components, format CycloneDX.","requirement":"Maintain a machine-readable SBOM of components (CRA Annex I, Part II).","status":"pass"}
{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-SCAN","note":"Vulnerability scan ran.","requirement":"Apply effective and regular security tests / vulnerability scanning.","status":"pass"}
{"id":"ANNEX-I-I-NO-KNOWN-EXPLOITABLE","note":"1 critical finding(s).","requirement":"Ship without known exploitable vulnerabilities (no Critical at release).","status":"fail"}
{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-REMEDIATE","note":"1 high finding(s) to triage.","requirement":"Remediate vulnerabilities without undue delay (track High and above).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-1-PRODUCT-IDENTITY","note":"SBOM declares the product as its top-level component (demo-app@1.0.0).","requirement":"Declare the product as the SBOM's top-level component (CycloneDX metadata.component) for traceability (CRA Annex I Part II).","status":"pass"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-1-SBOM-PROVENANCE","note":"SBOM is missing metadata.timestamp and/or metadata.tools; cannot evidence when/how it was generated.","requirement":"Record when and by which tool the SBOM was generated (metadata.timestamp + metadata.tools) so it is dated and attributable (CRA Annex I Part II).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-1-COMPONENT-IDENTIFIERS","note":"2 of 2 components lack a purl/CPE or version (2 missing an identifier, 0 missing a version).","requirement":"Give every SBOM component a package identifier (purl/CPE) and a version so it can be matched to vulnerability data (CRA Annex I Part II).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-1-COMPONENT-LICENSES","note":"Only 0/2 components carry license/SPDX data (0%). Advisory SBOM enrichment, not a CRA requirement.","requirement":"Record component license/SPDX data to enrich the SBOM evidence (SBOM-quality signal; the CRA does not mandate per-component licenses).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-I-2A-NO-KNOWN-EXPLOITED-KEV","note":"Not evaluated: the Grype database in use carries no known-exploited (KEV) enrichment.","requirement":"Ship with no components affected by known-exploited (CISA KEV) vulnerabilities (CRA Annex I Part I, no known exploitable vulnerabilities).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-I-2A-NO-UNFIXABLE-CRITICAL","note":"No unfixable Critical/High findings detected.","requirement":"Document a mitigation or risk decision for Critical/High findings that have no available upstream fix (CRA Annex I Part I/II).","status":"pass"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-2-FIX-AVAILABILITY","note":"1 High+ finding(s) have an available fixed version still present; apply the security update.","requirement":"Apply available security updates: surface High+ findings that already have a fixed version (CRA Annex I Part II, remediate without undue delay).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-3-SCAN-FRESHNESS","note":"Scan DB freshness unknown (descriptor.db.built absent or unparseable).","requirement":"Run vulnerability scans against a recently-updated database, evidencing regular testing (CRA Annex I Part II).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-5-CVD-POLICY","note":"Declared, not verified: only a security contact was declared in the run input. No SECURITY.md or security.txt was supplied, so no policy document was checked.","requirement":"Publish a coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure policy / security contact (SECURITY.md or security.txt) (CRA Annex I Part II points 5-6; Article 13).","status":"warn"}

{"id":"ANNEX-I-II-6-SECURITY-TXT","note":"No security.txt at .well-known/security.txt or /security.txt; a SECURITY.md may still satisfy point (6).","requirement":"Provide a machine-discoverable security contact via an RFC 9116 security.txt (CRA Annex I Part II point 6).","status":"warn"}
